title.suggested: Writer Says Old-Time Champions Like Tom Allen Were All Beaten

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch's New York correspondent mocked a critic of Jack Dempsey, arguing that old champions such as Sayers, Heenan, Mace and Tom Allen had all been beaten, while Dempsey never had.

metadata.notes: Running head: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Sunday, January 20, 1889, page 16. Telegraph letter from New York dated January 19, signed P. J.

facts.fact: The writer listed Allen among old champions who were beaten: Mace beat Allen, and Allen was whipped by Joe Goss

notes: Allen appears only in the closing paragraph.
